factProposals.value: Citizen requests and Blue Stakes tickets now arrive as drafted work orders; a work order is created only when a named person approves the draft.
Approving, correcting or rejecting an intake draft needs intake:approve (Supervisor or System administrator) with the person's own key or console session; outside systems cannot approve.

The intake agent drafts title, work type, priority, location and description from each source; an AI model can replace the rule-based stand-in behind the same interface, with its output checked before use.
Whether a drafted work order goes ahead, and in what form, is decided by a named person; fields the agent could not work out are filled in by that person.
An approval queue stating, for each draft, who performs the work and who must approve it, and a draft screen showing the agent's proposal next to the reviewer's version.
Which AI model the intake agent should use, the city's real list of work types, and who in the city performs and approves each kind of work are not known.

decisions.statement: Route citizen requests to drafts instead of creating work orders at once.
decisions.rationale: No work order may reach the live queue without a named person approving it; this changed STORY-003 behaviour with the student's approval.

decisions.statement: Use a clearly labelled rule-based stand-in for the agent until an AI model is provided.
decisions.rationale: No model or key is available; the human approval step is real either way, and a model plugs in later without other changes.

decisions.statement: Leave undetermined fields empty with a reason, and block approval until a person fills them in.
decisions.rationale: A guessed field would look like data the agent knew.

decisions.statement: Claim a draft before creating its work order, derive the work order's request id from the draft, and check the source fingerprint at approval.
decisions.rationale: Two reviewers at once must produce one work order, a retry must never duplicate it, and an approval must match the source as drafted.

limitations.statement: The intake agent is a keyword-based stand-in with a placeholder list of work types; no AI model is connected.
Every draft is routed to field crew to perform and a supervisor to approve; the city's real routing is not known.
Work orders created directly through the work order API by staff or authorised systems do not pass through intake; their named caller is the creator.
